answer_1.quote: We evaluate our proposed method on Egyptian (EGY) and Moroccan (MOR) Arabic dialects... evaluating its performance on tasks involving language understanding, translation, and alignment with cultural knowledge and values.

answer_2.quote: We conduct evaluations in both zero-shot and 4-shot settings, reporting results using ChrF++ and spBLEU scores.

answer_3.quote: We adopt an LLM-as-Judge methodology, employing Gemma-3-27b to rate the correctness of model-generated responses compared to ground-truth answers on a scale from 0 to 10.

answer_4.quote: Expert human annotator rated 100 randomly sampled items per dataset. To increase statistical power, a state-of-the-art LLM judge (Gemma 2.5 Pro) rated the same 100 items plus an additional 300 (400 total) per dataset.
answer_4.guideline: rated on two 1-5 scales: (i) Correctness (semantic accuracy/faithfulness) and (ii) Dialectness (authenticity and naturalness in Egyptian Arabic)
